name: BSS B2B Request a Quote
summary: Shopify app that hides prices behind an Add to quote button, lets merchants build quotes with custom prices and PO numbers, and converts them into draft orders.
best_for: Shopify stores that sell to business buyers and want to hide prices, collect quote requests and turn accepted quotes into draft orders
skip_if: you do not sell on Shopify, or you want public wholesale prices with no quote step
honest_knock: There is no free plan for a live store: Growth is $19 a month after a 14 day trial. Growth is capped at 5 quote logics, 5 custom form fields and 5 Quick Order pages, and quote logic per company sits in Enterprise at $79 a month. The margin view stays empty until you add a cost per product in Shopify. The refund page limits refunds to serious problems and asks you not to uninstall before contacting support. We found no usage fees or limits on staff accounts, so ask before you scale.

Business: $39/mo, or $398.40/yr (save 15%), unlimited quote requests and logics, custom form fields and Quick Order pages, 14-day free trial. Enterprise: $79/mo, or $806.40/yr (save 15%), all Business features plus quote logic per company customer, 14-day free trial. All plans are free on development and test stores. File uploads are capped at 10MB on Growth and 20MB on Business and Enterprise. We found no usage fees; the pages do not say whether any apply.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 24 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed the app, hid prices behind an Add to quote button, started the Growth trial without paying, built a quote for 10 units with a PO number and turned it into a Shopify draft order. We paid nothing.
findings: Install: the permission screen asked to view customer and staff data and to edit customers, products, orders, discounts and the Online Store.
Setup: a four step onboarding picked who asks for quotes, a Hide price + quote template and the storefront app embed in the theme editor, which has to be switched on and saved by hand.

Buyer side: with the template on, the product page showed Login to view prices and an Add to quote button instead of Add to cart, and the quote form asked for quantity, name, email and company details.

Plan: without a plan the Quotes screen said the feature was unavailable. Starting the Growth trial showed a Shopify test charge of $19 every 30 days after a 14 day trial, with no card asked and the note that we would not be billed.

Seller side: we created a quote for 10 units at our own unit price with a freight fee, saved it as In review and converted it to a draft order with our PO number. Shopify showed draft order #D11 about 8 minutes after install.
Margin: the margin box stayed empty until a product cost is added in Shopify.
Uninstall: the dialog asked for a reason, said app data is deleted and said a request to delete customer data goes to the developer within 48 hours.
